purpose: Teach: ホセ/ブライアン/アダム/チャイルド/エリック/ビリー/アンナ/ソロモン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがスペイン人のホセさんを紹介して下さるそうよ
lines.en: Your dad's going to introduce you to José, a friend from Spain.
lines.style: Warm and assured, like sharing something she knows will delight him. Slight lilt on the name. Unhurried, almost musical phrasing. The tone of someone offering a gift.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとブライアン・メイのギター演奏を観たよ
lines.en: Mei-chan, I watched Dad play guitar with Brian May!
lines.style: Bright, uncontainable excitement barely held in check. Quick tempo, eyes wide. The earnestness of a child who needs to share something real right now, not for approval but just to say it out loud.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「アダムとエヴァ」の絵本を読んで下さるわ
lines.en: Your dad's going to read you the picture book about Adam and Eve.
lines.style: Gentle certainty, as if confirming something lovely that's already decided. Slow, clear delivery. Slight warmth on the title. The cadence of someone reassuring a child about something good coming.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとチャイルドプレイスで遊んだよ
lines.en: Mei-chan, Dad and I played at Child's Place today!
lines.style: Bursting energy held just barely in place. Quick words tumbling over themselves. Pure joy without self-consciousness. The kind of breathless happiness only a small child can deliver without irony.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「エリックとは小説のヒーロー名」って教えて下さるわ
lines.en: Your dad told you that Eric is a hero's name from a novel.
lines.style: Thoughtful delivery, measured. Slight emphasis on 「エリック」 like she's helping him understand something important. Warm but not condescending. The patient tone of someone explaining the world to someone she loves.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとビリー・ジョエルの曲を聴いたよ
lines.en: Mei-chan, I listened to Billy Joel with Dad!
lines.style: Eager and warm, a little softer than before. Still quick, but with a note of contentment underneath. The satisfaction of sharing something special. Small child's pride in the experience itself.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「アンナの童話」を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Your dad's going to read you Anna's Fairy Tale.
lines.style: Calm anticipation, almost dreamy. Slower pace. Slight trailing quality at the end, like she's picturing it happening. Tender but not sentimental. The voice of someone who understands the quiet magic of bedtime stories.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「ソロモンの知恵」の絵本を読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-chan, Dad and I read the picture book about Solomon's Wisdom together!
lines.style: Soft contentment mixed with quiet pride. Slower pace than earlier, more grounded. Eyes warm. The calm joy of sharing something meaningful. A child reporting something that mattered to him, delivered with gentle sincerity.
